translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict advanced the Emperor to Area Commander of all armies within and without, sword and shoes in the hall, no hurrying in court entry, no naming in congratulatory bow, adding front and rear feather-canopies and drum-and-pipe — left and right Chief Administrators, Marshals, Attendant Gentlemen, Assistants, and Clerks each four, all according to old practice recruiting gentlemen — the rest all as before.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，齊帝進帝位相國，總百揆，封十郡為梁公，備九錫之禮，加遠遊冠，綠綟綬，位在諸王上。

translations.literal: On jiayin the Qi Emperor advanced the Emperor to Prince of the State, overseeing the hundred offices, enfeoffing ten commanderies as Duke of Liang, preparing the nine bestowals, adding the far-travel cap and green ribbon, rank above all princes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the Qi Emperor advanced the Emperor to Prince of the State, overseeing the hundred offices, enfeoffing ten commanderies as Duke of Liang, preparing the nine bestowals, adding the far-travel cap and green ribbon, rank above all princes.

sentences.zh: 策曰：

translations.literal: The investiture document says:
translations.idiomatic: The investiture document says:

sentences.zh: 上天不造，難鍾皇室，世祖以休明早崩，世宗以仁德不嗣。

translations.literal: Heaven does not aid — calamity strikes the imperial house; the Founding Emperor with bright virtue died early, the Heir Emperor with benevolent virtue left no successor.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven does not aid — calamity strikes the imperial house; the Founding Emperor with bright virtue died early, the Heir Emperor with benevolent virtue left no successor.

sentences.zh: 高宗襲統，宸居弗永，雖夙夜劬勞，而隆平不洽。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong inherited the succession; the imperial residence was not long — though from dawn to night he toiled, prosperous peace was not harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong inherited the succession; the imperial residence was not long — though from dawn to night he toiled, prosperous peace was not harmonized.

sentences.zh: 嗣君昏暴，書契弗睹，朝權國柄，委之群孽，剿戮忠賢，誅殘台輔，含冤抱痛，噍類靡餘。

translations.literal: The succeeding lord was benighted and cruel, never seeing the covenant texts; court power and state handle were entrusted to a pack of villains — they slaughtered the loyal and worthy, exterminated platform ministers; bearing wrongs and clutching pain, not a cry remained.
translations.idiomatic: The succeeding lord was benighted and cruel, never seeing the covenant texts; court power and state handle were entrusted to a pack of villains — they slaughtered the loyal and worthy, exterminated platform ministers; bearing wrongs and clutching pain, not a cry remained.

sentences.zh: 公藉昏明之期，因兆庶之願，爰率群後，翊成中興，宗社之危已固，天人之望允塞，此實公紐我絕綱，大造皇家者也。

translations.literal: My lord, relying on the period of darkness and brightness, following the myriad people's wish, then led the feudal lords and assisted the central revival — the altars' peril was already secured, heaven and men's hope truly fulfilled: this is truly my lord tying our broken net, greatly creating the imperial house.
translations.idiomatic: My lord, relying on the period of darkness and brightness, following the myriad people's wish, then led the feudal lords and assisted the central revival — the altars' peril was already secured, heaven and men's hope truly fulfilled: this is truly my lord tying our broken net, greatly creating the imperial house.

sentences.zh: 永明季年，邊隙大啟，荊河連率，招引戎荒。

translations.literal: In the last years of Yongming, border gaps opened greatly; Jing and He area commanders drew in barbarian wilds.
translations.idiomatic: In the last years of Yongming, border gaps opened greatly; Jing and He area commanders drew in barbarian wilds.

sentences.zh: 公受言本朝，輕兵赴襲，排危冒險，剛柔遞用，坦然一方，還成藩服，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: My lord received word from the court, light troops hurrying to strike, braving peril and danger, hard and soft in turn — calmly one region, returning to become a feudal service: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: My lord received word from the court, light troops hurrying to strike, braving peril and danger, hard and soft in turn — calmly one region, returning to become a feudal service: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 在昔隆昌，洪基已謝，高宗慮深社稷，將行權道。

translations.literal: In former times at Longchang, the great foundation was already departed; Emperor Gaozong thought deeply for the altars and was about to walk the path of expedient power.
translations.idiomatic: In former times at Longchang, the great foundation was already departed; Emperor Gaozong thought deeply for the altars and was about to walk the path of expedient power.

sentences.zh: 公定策帷帳，激揚大節，廢帝立王，謀猷深著，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: My lord fixed policy within the tent, roused great integrity, deposed an emperor and established a king — counsel deep and manifest: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: My lord fixed policy within the tent, roused great integrity, deposed an emperor and established a king — counsel deep and manifest: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 建武闡業，厥猷雖遠，戎狄內侵，憑陵關塞，司部危逼，淪陷指期。

translations.literal: Jianwu opened the enterprise — though the plan was far, barbarians invaded within, relying on passes and barriers; Si Province pressed in peril, fall imminent at a finger's touch.
translations.idiomatic: Jianwu opened the enterprise — though the plan was far, barbarians invaded within, relying on passes and barriers; Si Province pressed in peril, fall imminent at a finger's touch.

sentences.zh: 公總兵外討，卷甲長騖，焚廬毀帳，胡哭言歸，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: My lord gathered troops for external suppression, rolled armor and long gallop, burned huts and destroyed tents — the barbarians wept saying they returned: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: My lord gathered troops for external suppression, rolled armor and long gallop, burned huts and destroyed tents — the barbarians wept saying they returned: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 樊、漢阽切，羽書續至。

translations.literal: Fan and Han pressed to the brink; urgent dispatches came in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Fan and Han pressed to the brink; urgent dispatches came in succession.

sentences.zh: 公星言鞠旅，稟命徂征，拯我邊危，重獲安堵，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: My lord at star-rise marshaled troops, received mandate and went to campaign, saved our border peril, again obtained peace and dwelling: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: My lord at star-rise marshaled troops, received mandate and went to campaign, saved our border peril, again obtained peace and dwelling: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 漢南迥弱，咫尺勍寇。

translations.literal: South of the Han was distant and weak — a strong foe within a foot's reach.
translations.idiomatic: South of the Han was distant and weak — a strong foe within a foot's reach.

sentences.zh: 公作藩爰始，因資靡托，練兵訓卒，搜狩有序，俾我危城，翻為強鎮，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: My lord, beginning as feudal lord, with resources none to rely on, trained soldiers and drilled troops, hunts in order — made our perilous city turn into a strong garrison: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: My lord, beginning as feudal lord, with resources none to rely on, trained soldiers and drilled troops, hunts in order — made our perilous city turn into a strong garrison: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 永元紀號，瞻烏已及，雖廢昏有典，而伊、霍難行。

translations.literal: The Yongyuan era name — the crow looking already arrived; though deposing the benighted had precedent, yet Yi and Huo were hard to walk.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongyuan era name — the crow looking already arrived; though deposing the benighted had precedent, yet Yi and Huo were hard to walk.

sentences.zh: 公首建大策，爰立明聖，義踰邑綸，勳高代入，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: My lord first established the great plan, then established the bright sage — righteousness exceeding town and silk, merit higher than replacing men: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: My lord first established the great plan, then established the bright sage — righteousness exceeding town and silk, merit higher than replacing men: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 文王之風，雖被江、漢，京邑蠢蠢，湮為洪流。

translations.literal: King Wen's wind, though covering Jiang and Han — the capital teemed, submerged into a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: King Wen's wind, though covering Jiang and Han — the capital teemed, submerged into a great flood.

sentences.zh: 公投袂萬里，事惟拯溺，義聲所覃，無思不韙，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: My lord shook his sleeves ten thousand li — the affair only saving the drowning; where righteous fame reached, none thought it wrong: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: My lord shook his sleeves ten thousand li — the affair only saving the drowning; where righteous fame reached, none thought it wrong: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 魯城、夏汭，梗據中流，乘山置壘，縈川自固。

translations.literal: Lu city and Xia Rui blocked and held the middle current, riding mountains to set ramparts, winding rivers to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Lu city and Xia Rui blocked and held the middle current, riding mountains to set ramparts, winding rivers to hold firm.

sentences.zh: 公禦此烏集，陵茲地險，費無遺矢，戰未窮兵，踐華之固，相望俱拔，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: My lord faced this crow gathering, crossed this land's peril — expense not a stray arrow, battle not exhausting troops; the Hua's solidity, looking at each other both taken: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: My lord faced this crow gathering, crossed this land's peril — expense not a stray arrow, battle not exhausting troops; the Hua's solidity, looking at each other both taken: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 惟此群凶，同惡相濟，緣江負險，蟻聚加湖。

translations.literal: Only these evil hosts, same evil aiding each other, along the river relying on peril, ant-swarming at Jiahu.
translations.idiomatic: Only these evil hosts, same evil aiding each other, along the river relying on peril, ant-swarming at Jiahu.

sentences.zh: 桴旝一臨，應時褫潰，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: One arrival of boat-flags — at the time stripped and collapsed: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: One arrival of boat-flags — at the time stripped and collapsed: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 奸孽震皇，復懷舉斧，畜兵九派，用擬勤王。

translations.literal: Traitorous spawn shook the emperor, again harboring raised axe, storing troops at the Nine Branches, intending to aid the king in labor.
translations.idiomatic: Traitorous spawn shook the emperor, again harboring raised axe, storing troops at the Nine Branches, intending to aid the king in labor.

sentences.zh: 公棱威直指，勢踰風電，旌旆小臨，全州稽服，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: My lord's edge and might pointed straight — momentum exceeding wind and lightning; banners and flags slightly arrived — the whole province submitted: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: My lord's edge and might pointed straight — momentum exceeding wind and lightning; banners and flags slightly arrived — the whole province submitted: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 姑孰沖要，密邇京畿，凶徒熾聚，斷塞津路。

translations.literal: Gushu was strategic and vital, closely near the capital region — evil bands fiercely gathered, cutting and blocking ferry roads.
translations.idiomatic: Gushu was strategic and vital, closely near the capital region — evil bands fiercely gathered, cutting and blocking ferry roads.

sentences.zh: 公兵威所震，望旗自駭，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: Where my lord's martial might shook — seeing flags, they themselves were terrified: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: Where my lord's martial might shook — seeing flags, they themselves were terrified: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 群豎倡狂，志在借一，豕突淮涘，武騎如雲。

translations.literal: The evil hosts raised madness, intent on borrowing one throw — boar-rushing the Huai shore, martial horsemen like clouds.
translations.idiomatic: The evil hosts raised madness, intent on borrowing one throw — boar-rushing the Huai shore, martial horsemen like clouds.

sentences.zh: 公爰命英勇，因機騁銳，氣冠阪泉，勢踰洹水，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: My lord then ordered the brave, seizing the moment and galloping sharpness — spirit topping Banquan, momentum exceeding Huan water: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: My lord then ordered the brave, seizing the moment and galloping sharpness — spirit topping Banquan, momentum exceeding Huan water: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 琅邪、石首，襟帶岨固，新壘、東墉，金湯是埒，憑險作守，兵食兼資，風激電駭，莫不震疊，城復於隍，於是乎在，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: Langye and Shishou, belt and girdle rugged and firm; Xinlai and East Wall, metal and moat equal in strength — relying on peril to make defense, troops and grain both provided; wind stirred and lightning alarmed, none did not shake and fold; cities restored from the moat — therein it lay: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: Langye and Shishou, belt and girdle rugged and firm; Xinlai and East Wall, metal and moat equal in strength — relying on peril to make defense, troops and grain both provided; wind stirred and lightning alarmed, none did not shake and fold; cities restored from the moat — therein it lay: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 獨夫昏佷，憑城靡懼，鼓鍾鞺鞜，傲若有餘，狎是邪孽，忌斯冠冕，凶狡因之，將逞孥戮。

translations.literal: The lone man benighted and perverse, relying on the city without fear — drums and bells booming, proud as if with surplus; he befriended these evil spawn, envied these caps and robes — the vicious and cunning by this were about to extend slaughter to wives and children.
translations.idiomatic: The lone man benighted and perverse, relying on the city without fear — drums and bells booming, proud as if with surplus; he befriended these evil spawn, envied these caps and robes — the vicious and cunning by this were about to extend slaughter to wives and children.

sentences.zh: 公奇謀密運，威略潛回，忠勇之徒，得申厥效，白旗宣室，未之或比，此又公之功也。

translations.literal: My lord's strange plan secretly operated, martial strategy secretly returned — loyal and brave men obtained to declare their effect; white flags announced in the chamber — none to compare: this too is my lord's merit.
translations.idiomatic: My lord's strange plan secretly operated, martial strategy secretly returned — loyal and brave men obtained to declare their effect; white flags announced in the chamber — none to compare: this too is my lord's merit.

sentences.zh: 公有拯億兆之勳，重之以明德。

translations.literal: My lord has merit saving the hundred millions, heavy with bright virtue.
translations.idiomatic: My lord has merit saving the hundred millions, heavy with bright virtue.

sentences.zh: 爰初厲志，服道儒門，濯纓來仕，清猷映世。

translations.literal: At first he hardened his will, served the Way in the Confucian gate, washed his tassel to come to office — pure plan shining on the age.
translations.idiomatic: At first he hardened his will, served the Way in the Confucian gate, washed his tassel to come to office — pure plan shining on the age.

sentences.zh: 時運艱難，宗社危殆，昆岡已燎，玉石同焚，驅率貔貅，抑揚霆電，義等南巢，功齊牧野。

translations.literal: The times' transport was hard and perilous, altars nearly perished — the Kun mountain already burned, jade and stone burned together; driving and leading the brave warriors, restraining and releasing thunder and lightning — righteousness equal to South Nest, merit level with Muye.
translations.idiomatic: The times' transport was hard and perilous, altars nearly perished — the Kun mountain already burned, jade and stone burned together; driving and leading the brave warriors, restraining and releasing thunder and lightning — righteousness equal to South Nest, merit level with Muye.

sentences.zh: 若夫禹功寂寞，微管誰嗣，拯其將魚，驅其袒發，解茲亂網，理此棼絲，復禮衽席，反樂河海。

translations.literal: As for Yu's merit lonely, who after Guan Zhong — saving those about to be fish, driving those baring shoulders, undoing this tangled net, ordering this tangled silk, restoring ritual mats, returning joy to river and sea.
translations.idiomatic: As for Yu's merit lonely, who after Guan Zhong — saving those about to be fish, driving those baring shoulders, undoing this tangled net, ordering this tangled silk, restoring ritual mats, returning joy to river and sea.

sentences.zh: 永平故事，聞之者歎息，司隸舊章，見之者隕涕，請我人命，還之鬥極，憫憫縉紳，重符戴天之慶，哀哀黔首，復蒙履地之恩，德踰於嵩、岱，功鄰於造物，超哉邈矣，越無得而言焉。

translations.literal: The Yongping old story — hearing it one sighs; the Minister of Justice old statutes — seeing them one sheds tears; begging our people's lives, returning them to the Dipper Pole; sorrowful the gentry silk, again bearing heaven-bearing celebration; mournful the black-headed people, again receiving treading-earth grace — virtue exceeding Song and Dai, merit neighboring on creation; transcendent and far — beyond words to speak.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongping old story — hearing it one sighs; the Minister of Justice old statutes — seeing them one sheds tears; begging our people's lives, returning them to the Dipper Pole; sorrowful the gentry silk, again bearing heaven-bearing celebration; mournful the black-headed people, again receiving treading-earth grace — virtue exceeding Song and Dai, merit neighboring on creation; transcendent and far — beyond words to speak.

sentences.zh: 朕又聞之：疇庸命德，建侯作屏，咸用克固四維，永隆萬葉。

translations.literal: I also hear: rewarding merit and commanding virtue, establishing marquises to make screens — all used to firmly secure the four corners, forever prosper the myriad leaves.
translations.idiomatic: I also hear: rewarding merit and commanding virtue, establishing marquises to make screens — all used to firmly secure the four corners, forever prosper the myriad leaves.

sentences.zh: 是以二南流化，九伯斯征，王道淳洽，刑厝罔用。

translations.literal: Therefore the Two Souths flowed with transformation, the nine earls thus campaigned — kingly Way pure and harmonized, punishments set aside unused.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Two Souths flowed with transformation, the nine earls thus campaigned — kingly Way pure and harmonized, punishments set aside unused.

sentences.zh: 惟公經綸天地，甯濟區夏，道冠乎伊、稷，賞薄于桓、文，豈所以憲章齊、魯，長轡宇宙。

translations.literal: Only my lord weaves heaven and earth, pacifies and aids the central Xia — the Way crowns Yi and Ji, reward thin compared to Huan and Wen; how could this model Qi and Lu, long reins on the cosmos?
translations.idiomatic: Only my lord weaves heaven and earth, pacifies and aids the central Xia — the Way crowns Yi and Ji, reward thin compared to Huan and Wen; how could this model Qi and Lu, long reins on the cosmos?

sentences.zh: 敬惟前烈，朕甚懼焉。

translations.literal: Reverently considering former blazing merit — I am very afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently considering former blazing merit — I am very afraid.

sentences.zh: 今進授相國，改揚州刺史為牧，以豫州之梁郡曆陽、南徐州之義興、揚州之淮南宣城吳吳興會稽新安東陽十郡，封公為梁公，錫茲白土，苴以白茅，爰定爾邦，用建塚社。

translations.literal: Now advancing and conferring Prince of the State, changing Governor of Yang Province to Governor; with Liang Commandery of Yu Province, Liyang, Yixing of Southern Xu, Huainan, Xuancheng, Wu, Wuxing, Kuaiji, Xin'an, and Dongyang of Yang Province — ten commanderies — enfeoffing my lord as Duke of Liang, bestowing this white earth, wrapping with white thatch, thereby fixing your state, thereby establishing altar and soil.
translations.idiomatic: Now advancing and conferring Prince of the State, changing Governor of Yang Province to Governor; with Liang Commandery of Yu Province, Liyang, Yixing of Southern Xu, Huainan, Xuancheng, Wu, Wuxing, Kuaiji, Xin'an, and Dongyang of Yang Province — ten commanderies — enfeoffing my lord as Duke of Liang, bestowing this white earth, wrapping with white thatch, thereby fixing your state, thereby establishing altar and soil.

sentences.zh: 在昔旦、奭，入居保佑，逮于畢、毛，亦作卿士，任兼內外，禮實宜之。

translations.literal: In former times Dan and Shi entered to dwell in protection and blessing; reaching Bi and Mao, they also served as ministers — duty combining inner and outer, ritual truly fitting.
translations.idiomatic: In former times Dan and Shi entered to dwell in protection and blessing; reaching Bi and Mao, they also served as ministers — duty combining inner and outer, ritual truly fitting.

sentences.zh: 今命使持節、兼太尉王亮授相國揚州牧印綬、梁公璽紱；

translations.literal: Now ordering Bearer of the Staff, Concurrent Grand Commandant Wang Liang to confer Prince of the State, Governor of Yang seals and cords, Duke of Liang seal and ribbon;
translations.idiomatic: Now ordering Bearer of the Staff, Concurrent Grand Commandant Wang Liang to confer Prince of the State, Governor of Yang seals and cords, Duke of Liang seal and ribbon;

sentences.zh: 使持節、兼司空王志授梁公茅土，金虎符第一至第五左，竹使符第一至第十左。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, Concurrent Minister of Works Wang Zhi to confer Duke of Liang's earth and thatch, gold tiger tallies first through fifth left, bamboo envoy tallies first through tenth left.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff, Concurrent Minister of Works Wang Zhi to confer Duke of Liang's earth and thatch, gold tiger tallies first through fifth left, bamboo envoy tallies first through tenth left.

sentences.zh: 相國位冠群後，任總百司，恒典彝數，宜與事革。

translations.literal: Prince of the State's rank crowns the feudal lords, duty totals the hundred offices — constant codes and regular numbers should change with the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of the State's rank crowns the feudal lords, duty totals the hundred offices — constant codes and regular numbers should change with the affair.

sentences.zh: 其以相國總百揆，去錄尚書之號，上所假節、侍中貂蟬、中書監印、中外都督大司馬印綬、建安公印策，驃騎大將軍如故。

translations.literal: Let Prince of the State oversee the hundred offices, remove the title Recorder of the Masters of Writing; the above-conferred staff, Attendant-in-Ordinary cicada and cap, Director of the Masters of Writing seal, Area Commander within and without Grand Marshal seals and cords, Duke of Jian'an seal and investiture — General of Agile Cavalry as before.
translations.idiomatic: Let Prince of the State oversee the hundred offices, remove the title Recorder of the Masters of Writing; the above-conferred staff, Attendant-in-Ordinary cicada and cap, Director of the Masters of Writing seal, Area Commander within and without Grand Marshal seals and cords, Duke of Jian'an seal and investiture — General of Agile Cavalry as before.

sentences.zh: 又加公九錫，其敬聽後命：

translations.literal: Also adding my lord the nine bestowals — reverently hear the later command:
translations.idiomatic: Also adding my lord the nine bestowals — reverently hear the later command:

sentences.zh: 以公禮律兼修，刑德備舉，哀矜折獄，罔不用情。

translations.literal: Because my lord ritual and law both cultivated, punishment and virtue both raised, pitying in judging cases — none not using feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Because my lord ritual and law both cultivated, punishment and virtue both raised, pitying in judging cases — none not using feeling.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公大輅、戎輅各一，玄牡二駟。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowing my lord great carriage and war carriage each one, black stallions two teams of four.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowing my lord great carriage and war carriage each one, black stallions two teams of four.

sentences.zh: 公勞心稼穡，念在人天，丕崇務本，惟穀是寶。

translations.literal: My lord toils at heart for grain, thought on men and heaven, greatly honoring the root affair, only grain is treasure.
translations.idiomatic: My lord toils at heart for grain, thought on men and heaven, greatly honoring the root affair, only grain is treasure.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公兗冕之服，赤舄副焉。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowing my lord robes of the sacrificial cap, red shoes accompanying.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowing my lord robes of the sacrificial cap, red shoes accompanying.

sentences.zh: 公鎔鈞所被，變風以雅，易俗陶人，載和邦國。

translations.literal: My lord's melting balance what it covers — changing wind into elegance, changing custom and molding men, harmonizing and carrying the state.
translations.idiomatic: My lord's melting balance what it covers — changing wind into elegance, changing custom and molding men, harmonizing and carrying the state.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公軒縣之樂，六佾之舞。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowing my lord suspended music of the hall, six rows of dancers.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowing my lord suspended music of the hall, six rows of dancers.

sentences.zh: 公文德廣覃，義聲遠洽，椎髻髽首，夷歌請吏。

translations.literal: My lord's civil virtue broadly reaching, righteous fame far harmonized — topknot and mourning-bun, barbarian songs requesting officials.
translations.idiomatic: My lord's civil virtue broadly reaching, righteous fame far harmonized — topknot and mourning-bun, barbarian songs requesting officials.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公朱戶以居。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowing my lord vermilion doors to dwell.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowing my lord vermilion doors to dwell.

sentences.zh: 公揚清抑濁，官方有序，多士聿興，棫樸流詠。

translations.literal: My lord raises the pure and suppresses the turbid — official ranks have order, many scholars thus rise, elm clumps flowing in song.
translations.idiomatic: My lord raises the pure and suppresses the turbid — official ranks have order, many scholars thus rise, elm clumps flowing in song.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公納陛以登。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowing my lord ascending steps to mount.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowing my lord ascending steps to mount.

sentences.zh: 公正色禦下，以身範物，式遏不虞，折沖惟遠。

translations.literal: My lord with correct color governs subordinates, with body models things, checking the unlooked-for, breaking enemy from afar.
translations.idiomatic: My lord with correct color governs subordinates, with body models things, checking the unlooked-for, breaking enemy from afar.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公虎賁之士三百人。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowing my lord three hundred tiger-guardsmen.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowing my lord three hundred tiger-guardsmen.

sentences.zh: 公威同夏日，志清奸宄，放命圮族，刑茲罔赦。

translations.literal: My lord's might equal to summer sun, will to clear treacherous villains — defying mandate and destroying clan, punish them without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: My lord's might equal to summer sun, will to clear treacherous villains — defying mandate and destroying clan, punish them without pardon.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公鈇鉞各一。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowing my lord axe and yue each one.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowing my lord axe and yue each one.

sentences.zh: 公跨躡嵩溟，陵厲區宇，譬諸日月，容光必至。

translations.literal: My lord strides over Song heights and northern sea, crosses and overcomes the realm — compared to sun and moon, radiance must arrive.
translations.idiomatic: My lord strides over Song heights and northern sea, crosses and overcomes the realm — compared to sun and moon, radiance must arrive.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公彤弓一、彤矢百，盧弓十、盧矢千。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowing my lord red bow one, red arrows one hundred, black bows ten, black arrows one thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowing my lord red bow one, red arrows one hundred, black bows ten, black arrows one thousand.

sentences.zh: 公永言惟孝，至感通神，恭嚴祀典，祭有餘敬。

translations.literal: My lord forever speaks only filial piety — utmost feeling penetrating the spirits, reverent and strict in sacrificial codes, sacrifice with surplus reverence.
translations.idiomatic: My lord forever speaks only filial piety — utmost feeling penetrating the spirits, reverent and strict in sacrificial codes, sacrifice with surplus reverence.

sentences.zh: 是用錫金秬鬯一卣，圭瓚副焉。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowing black millet-leaven wine one jar, jade libation cup accompanying.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowing black millet-leaven wine one jar, jade libation cup accompanying.

sentences.zh: 梁國置丞相以下，一遵舊式。

translations.literal: The Liang state establishes Chancellor and below — all following old forms.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang state establishes Chancellor and below — all following old forms.

sentences.zh: 欽哉，其敬循往策，祗服大禮，對揚天眷，用膺多福，以弘我太祖之休命。

translations.literal: Reverence! Reverently follow former policy, reverently serve the great rites, answering and displaying heaven's favor, thereby receiving much blessing, thereby expanding our High Ancestor's fine mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Reverence! Reverently follow former policy, reverently serve the great rites, answering and displaying heaven's favor, thereby receiving much blessing, thereby expanding our High Ancestor's fine mandate.

sentences.zh: 帝固辭，府僚勸進，不許。

translations.literal: The Emperor firmly declined; staff urged advance — he did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor firmly declined; staff urged advance — he did not permit.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，府僚重請曰：「近以朝命蘊策，冒奏丹誠，奉被還令，未蒙虛受，縉紳顒顒，深所未達。

translations.literal: On xinyou of the second month, staff again requested, saying, "Recently by court command the investiture was prepared; we presumed to report red sincerity, received return order, not granted empty acceptance — the gentry silk eager, deeply what is not yet understood.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the second month, staff again requested, saying, "Recently by court command the investiture was prepared; we presumed to report red sincerity, received return order, not granted empty acceptance — the gentry silk eager, deeply what is not yet understood.

sentences.zh: 蓋聞受金於府，通人之弘致，高蹈海隅，匹夫之小節，是以履乘石而周公不以為疑，贈玉璜而太公不以為讓。

translations.literal: I hear receiving gold from the treasury is the broad intent of the penetrating man; high treading the sea corner is the small integrity of the lone man — therefore treading the stone steps and Duke of Zhou did not take it as doubt; bestowing the jade tablet and Grand Duke did not take it as yielding.
translations.idiomatic: I hear receiving gold from the treasury is the broad intent of the penetrating man; high treading the sea corner is the small integrity of the lone man — therefore treading the stone steps and Duke of Zhou did not take it as doubt; bestowing the jade tablet and Grand Duke did not take it as yielding.

sentences.zh: 況世哲繼軌，先德在人，經綸草昧，歎深微管，加以朱方之役，荊河是依，班師振旅，大造王室，雖復累繭救宋，重胝存楚，居今觀古，曾何足云。

translations.literal: How much more when the age's sage continues the track, former virtue in men — weaving the cosmos in grass and darkness, sighing deeply for the slight Guan; adding the Zhufang campaign, Jing and He thereby relied — withdrawing the army and shaking the host, greatly creating the royal house; though again piled cocoons saving Song, heavy calluses preserving Chu — viewing today by the ancient, how could it suffice to speak?
translations.idiomatic: How much more when the age's sage continues the track, former virtue in men — weaving the cosmos in grass and darkness, sighing deeply for the slight Guan; adding the Zhufang campaign, Jing and He thereby relied — withdrawing the army and shaking the host, greatly creating the royal house; though again piled cocoons saving Song, heavy calluses preserving Chu — viewing today by the ancient, how could it suffice to speak?

sentences.zh: 而惑甚盜鍾，功疑不賞，皇天后土，不勝其酷。

translations.literal: Yet confusion extreme as stealing the bell, merit doubted and not rewarded — heaven and earth, unable to bear its cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: Yet confusion extreme as stealing the bell, merit doubted and not rewarded — heaven and earth, unable to bear its cruelty.

sentences.zh: 是以玉馬駿奔，表微子之去，金板出地，告龍逄之冤。

translations.literal: Therefore the jade horses galloped away, displaying Weizi's departure; the gold board came from earth, reporting Longfeng's wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the jade horses galloped away, displaying Weizi's departure; the gold board came from earth, reporting Longfeng's wrong.

sentences.zh: 明公據鞍輟哭，厲三軍之志，獨居掩涕，激義士之心，故能使海若登只，罄圖效祉，山戎、孤竹，束馬景從，伐罪吊人，一匡靜亂，匪叨天功，實勤濡足。

translations.literal: My lord, holding the saddle stopped weeping, roused the three armies' will; dwelling alone covered tears, stirred righteous men's hearts — therefore able to make sea-spirits ascend and only, empty the chart and display blessing; Mountain Barbarians and Lone Bamboo bound horses and followed the scene; punishing crime and comforting men, one correction and quiet disorder — not presumptuous on heaven's merit, truly toiling with wet feet.
translations.idiomatic: My lord, holding the saddle stopped weeping, roused the three armies' will; dwelling alone covered tears, stirred righteous men's hearts — therefore able to make sea-spirits ascend and only, empty the chart and display blessing; Mountain Barbarians and Lone Bamboo bound horses and followed the scene; punishing crime and comforting men, one correction and quiet disorder — not presumptuous on heaven's merit, truly toiling with wet feet.

sentences.zh: 龜玉不毀，誰之功歟，獨為君子，將使伊、周何地。

translations.literal: Turtle and jade not destroyed — whose merit? Alone to be the noble man — will you make Yi and Zhou stand where?
translations.idiomatic: Turtle and jade not destroyed — whose merit? Alone to be the noble man — will you make Yi and Zhou stand where?

sentences.zh: 」於是始受相國、梁公之命。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he first accepted the mandate of Prince of the State and Duke of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: "Thereupon he first accepted the mandate of Prince of the State and Duke of Liang.

sentences.zh: 命焚東昏淫奢異服六十二種於都街。

translations.literal: He ordered burned at the capital street Donghun's sixty-two kinds of lewd luxury and strange garb.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered burned at the capital street Donghun's sixty-two kinds of lewd luxury and strange garb.

sentences.zh: 齊帝追贈梁公夫人為梁國妃。

translations.literal: The Qi Emperor posthumously honored the Duke of Liang's consort as Consort of the Liang State.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi Emperor posthumously honored the Duke of Liang's consort as Consort of the Liang State.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，南兗州隊主陳文興于宣武城內鑿井，得玉鏤騏驎、金鏤玉璧、水精環各二。

translations.literal: On yichou, a squad leader of Southern Yanzhou Chen Wenxing, digging a well within Xuanyang city, obtained jade carved qilin, gold carved jade bi, and crystal rings — two each.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, a squad leader of Southern Yanzhou Chen Wenxing, digging a well within Xuanyang city, obtained jade carved qilin, gold carved jade bi, and crystal rings — two each.

sentences.zh: 又鳳凰見建康縣桐下里。

translations.literal: Also phoenix appeared at Tongxia Village, Jiankang County.
translations.idiomatic: Also phoenix appeared at Tongxia Village, Jiankang County.

sentences.zh: 宣德皇后稱美符瑞，歸於相國府。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Xuande praised the auspicious omens and attributed them to the Prince of the State's office.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Xuande praised the auspicious omens and attributed them to the Prince of the State's office.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔梁國依舊選諸要職，悉依天朝之制。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict ordered the Liang state according to old practice to select all key posts — all following the heavenly court's system.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, an edict ordered the Liang state according to old practice to select all key posts — all following the heavenly court's system.

sentences.zh: 帝上表，以「前代選官，皆立選簿，請自今選曹，精加隱括，依舊立簿，使冠履無爽，名實不違，庶人識涯涘，造請自息。

translations.literal: The Emperor submitted a memorial, saying, "Former ages in selecting officials all established selection registers — I request from now the Selection Bureau carefully add hidden examination, according to old practice establish registers, making cap and shoes without error, name and reality not violated — common people will know the shore, seeking audience will itself cease.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor submitted a memorial, saying, "Former ages in selecting officials all established selection registers — I request from now the Selection Bureau carefully add hidden examination, according to old practice establish registers, making cap and shoes without error, name and reality not violated — common people will know the shore, seeking audience will itself cease.

sentences.zh: 且聞中間立格，甲族以二十登仕，後門以過立試吏，豈所以弘獎風流，希向後進。

translations.literal: And I hear in the middle a standard was established — noble clans at twenty enter office, lesser gates by passing established as trial clerks — how is this to expand and reward elegant custom, hoping toward later comers?
translations.idiomatic: And I hear in the middle a standard was established — noble clans at twenty enter office, lesser gates by passing established as trial clerks — how is this to expand and reward elegant custom, hoping toward later comers?

sentences.zh: 此實巨蠹，尤宜刊革」。

translations.literal: This is truly a great borer — especially should be cut and reformed."
translations.idiomatic: This is truly a great borer — especially should be cut and reformed."

sentences.zh: 詔依表施行。

translations.literal: An edict followed the memorial and implemented.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed the memorial and implemented.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔進梁公爵為王，以豫州之南譙廬江、江州之尋陽、郢州之武昌西陽、南徐州之南琅邪南東海晉陵、揚州之臨海永嘉十郡益梁國，並前為二十郡。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict advanced the Duke of Liang's rank to King, adding Southern Qiao and Lujiang of Yu Province, Xunyang of Jiang Province, Wuchang and Xiyang of Ying Province, Southern Langye, Southern Donghai, and Jinling of Southern Xu, Linhai and Yongjia of Yang Province — ten commanderies to increase the Liang state, together with the former making twenty commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, an edict advanced the Duke of Liang's rank to King, adding Southern Qiao and Lujiang of Yu Province, Xunyang of Jiang Province, Wuchang and Xiyang of Ying Province, Southern Langye, Southern Donghai, and Jinling of Southern Xu, Linhai and Yongjia of Yang Province — ten commanderies to increase the Liang state, together with the former making twenty commanderies.

sentences.zh: 其相國、揚州牧、驃騎大將軍如故。

translations.literal: Prince of the State, Governor of Yang, General of Agile Cavalry — all as before.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of the State, Governor of Yang, General of Agile Cavalry — all as before.

sentences.zh: 帝固辭，有詔斷表。

translations.literal: The Emperor firmly declined; there was an edict cutting off the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor firmly declined; there was an edict cutting off the memorial.

sentences.zh: 相國左長史王瑩等率百僚敦請。

translations.literal: Left Chief Administrator of the Prince of the State Wang Ying and others led the hundred officials in earnest urging.
translations.idiomatic: Left Chief Administrator of the Prince of the State Wang Ying and others led the hundred officials in earnest urging.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，受梁王之命。

translations.literal: On guisi of the third month, he accepted the mandate of King of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the third month, he accepted the mandate of King of Liang.

sentences.zh: 下令赦國內殊死以下，鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，賜穀五斛，府州所統亦同蠲蕩。

translations.literal: He ordered amnesty within the state for exceptional death and below; widows, orphans, solitary and alone unable to support themselves — bestow five hu of grain; prefectures and provinces under jurisdiction likewise remit and abolish.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered amnesty within the state for exceptional death and below; widows, orphans, solitary and alone unable to support themselves — bestow five hu of grain; prefectures and provinces under jurisdiction likewise remit and abolish.

sentences.zh: 丙午，齊帝命帝冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕，乘金根車，駕六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭雲罕，樂舞八佾，設鍾虡宮縣，王妃、王子、王女爵命之號，一如舊儀。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Qi Emperor ordered the Emperor's cap to have twelve tassels, establish the Son of Heaven's banners and flags, exit with police and enter with prohibition, ride the golden-root carriage, drive six horses, prepare five-season secondary carriages, establish plume-head and cloud-banner, music and dance eight rows, establish bell-frames and palace suspended bells — consort, princes, and princesses titles and commands all as old rites.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the Qi Emperor ordered the Emperor's cap to have twelve tassels, establish the Son of Heaven's banners and flags, exit with police and enter with prohibition, ride the golden-root carriage, drive six horses, prepare five-season secondary carriages, establish plume-head and cloud-banner, music and dance eight rows, establish bell-frames and palace suspended bells — consort, princes, and princesses titles and commands all as old rites.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，齊帝下詔禪位，即安姑孰。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Qi Emperor issued an edict abdicating; he then settled at An Gushu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the Qi Emperor issued an edict abdicating; he then settled at An Gushu.

sentences.zh: 四月辛酉，宣德皇后令曰：「西詔至，帝憲章前代，敬禪神器于梁，明可臨軒，遣使恭授璽紱，未亡人便歸於別宮。

translations.literal: On xinyou of the fourth month, Empress Dowager Xuande ordered, "The western edict has arrived — the Emperor models former ages, reverently abdicating the divine vessel to Liang; tomorrow may he ascend the throne; dispatch envoys to reverently confer seals and cords — the un-widowed woman will then return to the separate palace."
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the fourth month, Empress Dowager Xuande ordered, "The western edict has arrived — the Emperor models former ages, reverently abdicating the divine vessel to Liang; tomorrow may he ascend the throne; dispatch envoys to reverently confer seals and cords — the un-widowed woman will then return to the separate palace."

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，策曰：

translations.literal: On renxu, the investiture document says:
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the investiture document says:

sentences.zh: 咨爾梁王，惟昔邃古之載，肇有生靈，皇雄、大庭之辟，赫胥、尊盧之後，斯並龍圖鳥跡以前，慌惚杳冥之世，固無得而詳焉。

translations.literal: Consult you, King of Liang — in records of remote antiquity, when living beings first arose, the sovereigns Huangxiong and Dating, after Heru and Zunlu — these all before dragon charts and bird tracks, in dim vague oblivion — inherently none to detail.
translations.idiomatic: Consult you, King of Liang — in records of remote antiquity, when living beings first arose, the sovereigns Huangxiong and Dating, after Heru and Zunlu — these all before dragon charts and bird tracks, in dim vague oblivion — inherently none to detail.

sentences.zh: 洎乎農、軒、炎、皞之代，放勳、重華之主，莫不以大道君萬姓，公器禦八紘，居之如執朽索，去之若釋重負，一駕汾陽，便有窅然之志，暫適箕嶺，即動讓王之心。

translations.literal: Reaching the generations of Shennong, Xuanyuan, Yandi, and Haohao, the lords Fangxun and Chonghua — none did not with the Great Way lord the myriad surname, with the public vessel govern the eight directions — dwelling as if holding a rotten rope, departing as if releasing a heavy burden; one driving to Fenyang, then had distant ambition; briefly going to Jiling, then moved the yielding-king heart.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the generations of Shennong, Xuanyuan, Yandi, and Haohao, the lords Fangxun and Chonghua — none did not with the Great Way lord the myriad surname, with the public vessel govern the eight directions — dwelling as if holding a rotten rope, departing as if releasing a heavy burden; one driving to Fenyang, then had distant ambition; briefly going to Jiling, then moved the yielding-king heart.

sentences.zh: 故知戴黃屋、服玉璽，非所以示貴稱尊，乘大輅、建旗旗，蓋欲令歸趣有地。

translations.literal: Therefore know wearing yellow house and serving jade seal — not thereby to display nobility and call respect; riding great carriage and establishing banners and flags — probably intending to make return and tendency have place.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore know wearing yellow house and serving jade seal — not thereby to display nobility and call respect; riding great carriage and establishing banners and flags — probably intending to make return and tendency have place.

sentences.zh: 是故忘己而字兆庶，徇物而君四海。

translations.literal: Therefore forgetting self and nurturing the myriad masses, yielding to things and lording the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore forgetting self and nurturing the myriad masses, yielding to things and lording the four seas.

sentences.zh: 及于菁華內竭，畚橇外勞，則撫茲歸運，惟能是與。

translations.literal: Reaching essence and flower exhausted within, basket and spade laboring without — then comforting this returning mandate, only the able is given.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching essence and flower exhausted within, basket and spade laboring without — then comforting this returning mandate, only the able is given.

sentences.zh: 四百告終，有漢所以高揖，黃德既謝，魏氏所以樂推。

translations.literal: Four hundred ended and reported — Han therefore high yielded; yellow virtue already departed — Wei therefore joyfully pushed.
translations.idiomatic: Four hundred ended and reported — Han therefore high yielded; yellow virtue already departed — Wei therefore joyfully pushed.

sentences.zh: 爰及晉、宋，亦弘斯典。

translations.literal: Reaching Jin and Song — also expanded this canon.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Jin and Song — also expanded this canon.

sentences.zh: 我太祖握河受曆，應符啟運，二葉重光，三聖系軌。

translations.literal: Our High Ancestor grasped the river and received the calendar, responded to the talisman and opened the mandate — two generations doubled brilliance, three sages linked tracks.
translations.idiomatic: Our High Ancestor grasped the river and received the calendar, responded to the talisman and opened the mandate — two generations doubled brilliance, three sages linked tracks.

sentences.zh: 嗣君喪德，昏棄紀度，毀紊天綱，雕絕地紐。

translations.literal: The succeeding lord lost virtue, benightedly abandoned measure and degree, destroyed and tangled heaven's net, carved and severed earth's cords.
translations.idiomatic: The succeeding lord lost virtue, benightedly abandoned measure and degree, destroyed and tangled heaven's net, carved and severed earth's cords.

sentences.zh: 是以谷滿川枯，山飛鬼哭，七廟已危，人神無主。

translations.literal: Therefore valleys full and rivers dry, mountains flying and ghosts weeping — seven temples already perilous, men and spirits without master.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore valleys full and rivers dry, mountains flying and ghosts weeping — seven temples already perilous, men and spirits without master.

sentences.zh: 惟王體茲上哲，明聖在躬，端冕而協邕熙，推鋒而拯塗炭，武功與日車並運，文教與鵬翼齊舉。

translations.literal: Only the King embodies this upper sage, bright sagacity in the body — correct cap and harmonizing grand harmony, pushing forward edge and saving the burning charcoal — martial achievement with the sun chariot together transported, civil teaching with the peng wing together raised.
translations.idiomatic: Only the King embodies this upper sage, bright sagacity in the body — correct cap and harmonizing grand harmony, pushing forward edge and saving the burning charcoal — martial achievement with the sun chariot together transported, civil teaching with the peng wing together raised.

sentences.zh: 固以幽顯宅心，謳訟斯屬；

translations.literal: Truly the hidden and manifest dwell in heart, songs of praise thereby belong;
translations.idiomatic: Truly the hidden and manifest alike took heart in him, and songs of praise gathered to his name;

sentences.zh: 豈徒桴鼓播地，卿雲叢天而已哉。

translations.literal: How could it be only drum and pestle spreading over earth, auspicious clouds clustering heaven?
translations.idiomatic: How could it be only drum and pestle spreading over earth, auspicious clouds clustering heaven?

sentences.zh: 至於晝睹爭明，夜飛枉矢，除舊之征必顯，更姓之符允集。

translations.literal: Reaching day seeing contending brightness, night flying crooked arrow — signs of removing the old must appear, talismans of changing surname truly gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching day seeing contending brightness, night flying crooked arrow — signs of removing the old must appear, talismans of changing surname truly gathered.

sentences.zh: 今便仰祗幹象，俯從人願，敬禪神器，授帝位於爾躬。

translations.literal: Now then reverently ascending the dry image, humbly following men's wish — reverently abdicating the divine vessel, conferring the imperial position on your person.
translations.idiomatic: Now then reverently ascending the dry image, humbly following men's wish — reverently abdicating the divine vessel, conferring the imperial position on your person.

sentences.zh: 大祚告窮，天祿永終。

translations.literal: Great mandate declares exhausted, heaven's blessing forever ended.
translations.idiomatic: Great mandate declares exhausted, heaven's blessing forever ended.

sentences.zh: 于戲，王允執其中，式遵前典，以副昊天之望，禋上帝而臨億兆，格文祖而膺大業，以傳無疆之祚，豈不盛與。

translations.literal: Alas! King, hold the center, model former canon, thereby answering bright heaven's hope, sacrifice to High God and face the hundred millions, approach the civil ancestor and receive the great enterprise, thereby transmitting boundless mandate — how is it not glorious!
translations.idiomatic: Alas! King, hold the center, model former canon, thereby answering bright heaven's hope, sacrifice to High God and face the hundred millions, approach the civil ancestor and receive the great enterprise, thereby transmitting boundless mandate — how is it not glorious!

sentences.zh: 並命璽書，遣兼太保、中書監、兼尚書令王亮，兼太尉、中書令王志奉皇帝璽紱，受終之禮，一依唐、虞故事。

translations.literal: Also ordering seal documents, dispatching Concurrent Grand Preceptor, Director of the Masters of Writing, Concurrent Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang, Concurrent Grand Commandant, Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Zhi to present the Emperor's seals and cords — the receiving-end rites all following Tang and Yu old stories.
translations.idiomatic: Also ordering seal documents, dispatching Concurrent Grand Preceptor, Director of the Masters of Writing, Concurrent Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang, Concurrent Grand Commandant, Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Zhi to present the Emperor's seals and cords — the receiving-end rites all following Tang and Yu old stories.

sentences.zh: 帝抗表陳讓，表不獲通。

translations.literal: The Emperor resisted with memorials declining; the memorials did not obtain passage.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor resisted with memorials declining; the memorials did not obtain passage.

sentences.zh: 於是齊百官豫章王元琳等八百一十九人，及梁台侍中範雲等一百一十七人，並上表勸進，帝謙讓不受。

translations.literal: Thereupon Qi hundred officials Prince of Yuzhang Yuanlin and eight hundred nineteen others, and Liang Platform Attendant-in-Ordinary Fan Yun and one hundred seventeen others, all submitted memorials urging advance — the Emperor modestly declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Qi hundred officials Prince of Yuzhang Yuanlin and eight hundred nineteen others, and Liang Platform Attendant-in-Ordinary Fan Yun and one hundred seventeen others, all submitted memorials urging advance — the Emperor modestly declined and did not accept.

sentences.zh: 是日，太史令蔣道秀陳天文符讖六十四條，事並明著，群臣重表固請，乃從之。

translations.literal: That day, Imperial Astronomer Jiang Daoxiu presented astronomical talismans and prognostications sixty-four items — affairs all clearly manifest; the ministers again memorialized firmly requesting — then he followed.
translations.idiomatic: That day, Imperial Astronomer Jiang Daoxiu presented astronomical talismans and prognostications sixty-four items — affairs all clearly manifest; the ministers again memorialized firmly requesting — then he followed.

sentences.zh: 天監元年夏四月丙寅，皇帝即位于南郊，設壇柴燎告天曰：皇帝臣衍，敢用玄牡，昭告於皇皇后帝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Tianjian, on bingyin, the Emperor took the throne at the Southern Altar, establishing the altar, burning firewood, announcing to heaven, saying: The Emperor, subject Yan, dare use black stallion, clearly announcing to August August Empress and Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Tianjian, on bingyin, the Emperor took the throne at the Southern Altar, establishing the altar, burning firewood, announcing to heaven, saying: The Emperor, subject Yan, dare use black stallion, clearly announcing to August August Empress and Emperor.

sentences.zh: 齊氏以曆運斯既，否終則亨，欽若天應，以命於衍。

translations.literal: The Qi clan's calendar mandate already ended, obstruction ended then prosperity — reverently following heaven's response, thereby commanding Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi clan's calendar mandate already ended, obstruction ended then prosperity — reverently following heaven's response, thereby commanding Yan.

sentences.zh: 夫任是司牧，惟能是授，天命不于常，帝王非一族，唐謝虞受，漢替魏升，爰及晉、宋，憲章在昔，咸以君德馭四海，元功子萬姓，故能大庇甿黎，光宅區宇。

translations.literal: To bear this stewardship, only the able is conferred; heaven's mandate is not constant, emperors and kings are not one clan — Tang yielded and Yu received, Han departed and Wei rose; reaching Jin and Song, modeling and statutes in former times — all thereby with lordly virtue governing the four seas, original merit tending the myriad surname, therefore able greatly to shelter the black-headed, gloriously dwelling the realm.
translations.idiomatic: To bear this stewardship, only the able is conferred; heaven's mandate is not constant, emperors and kings are not one clan — Tang yielded and Yu received, Han departed and Wei rose; reaching Jin and Song, modeling and statutes in former times — all thereby with lordly virtue governing the four seas, original merit tending the myriad surname, therefore able greatly to shelter the black-headed, gloriously dwelling the realm.

sentences.zh: 齊代雲季，世主昏凶，狡焉群慝，是崇是長，肆厥奸回暴亂，以播虐於我有邦，俾九服八荒之內，連率嶽牧之君，蹶角頓顙，匡救無術。

translations.literal: The Qi age's cloud end — age-lords benighted and vicious, craftily the pack of villains, this they honored, this they lengthened, spreading their treacherous rebellion and violent disorder, thereby broadcasting cruelty in our state — making within the nine domains and eight wastes, area-commander and mountain-lord rulers, horns knocked and brows bowed, rescue without method.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi age's cloud end — age-lords benighted and vicious, craftily the pack of villains, this they honored, this they lengthened, spreading their treacherous rebellion and violent disorder, thereby broadcasting cruelty in our state — making within the nine domains and eight wastes, area-commander and mountain-lord rulers, horns knocked and brows bowed, rescue without method.

sentences.zh: 衍投袂星言，推鋒萬里，厲其掛冠之情，用拯兆庶之切，遂因時來，宰司邦國，濟物康世，實有厥勞。

translations.literal: Yan shook sleeves at star-rise, pushed edge ten thousand li, roused his hanging-cap feeling, thereby saving the myriad masses' urgency — then following the timely coming, overseeing the state country, aiding things and comforting the age, truly having that labor.
translations.idiomatic: Yan shook sleeves at star-rise, pushed edge ten thousand li, roused his hanging-cap feeling, thereby saving the myriad masses' urgency — then following the timely coming, overseeing the state country, aiding things and comforting the age, truly having that labor.

sentences.zh: 而晷緯呈祥，川嶽效祉，代終之符既顯，革運之期已萃，殊俗百蠻，重譯獻款，人神遠邇，罔不和會。

translations.literal: And gnomon and weft displayed auspicious signs, rivers and peaks displayed blessings — talismans of dynasty ending already manifest, periods of changing mandate already gathered; foreign customs and hundred barbarians, heavy translation presenting allegiance; men and spirits far and near, none not harmoniously meeting.
translations.idiomatic: And gnomon and weft displayed auspicious signs, rivers and peaks displayed blessings — talismans of dynasty ending already manifest, periods of changing mandate already gathered; foreign customs and hundred barbarians, heavy translation presenting allegiance; men and spirits far and near, none not harmoniously meeting.

sentences.zh: 於是群公卿士，咸致厥誠，並以皇幹降命，難以謙拒。

translations.literal: Thereupon the lords, ministers, and gentlemen all reached their sincerity, all with imperial stem descending command — hard to modestly refuse.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the lords, ministers, and gentlemen all reached their sincerity, all with imperial stem descending command — hard to modestly refuse.

sentences.zh: 衍自惟匪德，辭不獲遂，仰迫上玄之眷，俯惟億兆之心，宸極不可久曠，人神不可乏主，遂藉樂推，膺此嘉祚。

translations.literal: Yan himself considered lack of virtue, declined and did not obtain following — reverently pressed by High Mystery's favor, humbly considering the hundred millions' hearts — the polar star cannot long be vacant, men and spirits cannot lack master — then borrowing joyfully pushed, receiving this fine fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Yan himself considered lack of virtue, declined and did not obtain following — reverently pressed by High Mystery's favor, humbly considering the hundred millions' hearts — the polar star cannot long be vacant, men and spirits cannot lack master — then borrowing joyfully pushed, receiving this fine fortune.

sentences.zh: 以茲寡薄，臨馭萬方，顧求夙志，永言祗惕。

translations.literal: With this meager thinness, facing and governing the ten thousand directions — looking back seeking former will, forever speaking reverent fear.
translations.idiomatic: With this meager thinness, facing and governing the ten thousand directions — looking back seeking former will, forever speaking reverent fear.

sentences.zh: 敬簡元辰，恭茲大禮，升壇受禪，告類上帝，克播休祉，以弘盛烈，式傳厥後，用永保于我有梁，惟明靈是饗。

translations.literal: Reverently selecting the primary day, reverently this great rite — ascending the altar receiving abdication, announcing category to High God, able to spread fine blessing, thereby expanding flourishing merit, model transmitting to posterity, thereby forever preserving our Liang — only bright spirits be feasted.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently selecting the primary day, reverently this great rite — ascending the altar receiving abdication, announcing category to High God, able to spread fine blessing, thereby expanding flourishing merit, model transmitting to posterity, thereby forever preserving our Liang — only bright spirits be feasted.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，有詔放觀。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, there was an edict releasing viewing.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were complete, there was an edict releasing viewing.

sentences.zh: 乃備法駕還建康宮，臨太極前殿，大赦，改元，賜人爵二級，文武位二等；

translations.literal: Then preparing the law carriage returned to Jiankang Palace, facing the Supreme Ultimate front hall, general amnesty, changing era name, bestowing on men rank two grades, civil and military rank two grades;
translations.idiomatic: Then preparing the law carriage returned to Jiankang Palace, facing the Supreme Ultimate front hall, general amnesty, changing era name, bestowing on men rank two grades, civil and military rank two grades;

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，人穀五斛；

translations.literal: widows, orphans, solitary and alone unable to support themselves — per person five hu of grain;
translations.idiomatic: widows, orphans, solitary and alone unable to support themselves — per person five hu of grain;

sentences.zh: 逋布、口錢、宿責勿復收；

translations.literal: overdue cloth, head-tax money, old debts — do not again collect;
translations.idiomatic: overdue cloth, head-tax money, old debts — do not again collect;

sentences.zh: 其犯鄉論清議、贓汙淫盜，一皆蕩滌，洗除前注，與之更始。

translations.literal: those who violated village discourse pure discussion, corruption and pollution, lewdness and theft — all washed and cleared, scrubbing former notes, with them a new beginning.
translations.idiomatic: those who violated village discourse pure discussion, corruption and pollution, lewdness and theft — all washed and cleared, scrubbing former notes, with them a new beginning.

sentences.zh: 封齊帝為巴陵王，全食一郡，載天子旌旗，乘五時副車，行齊正朔，郊祀天地，禮樂制度，皆用齊典。

translations.literal: Enfeoffed the Qi Emperor as King of Baling, full sustenance one commandery, bearing Son of Heaven banners and flags, riding five-season secondary carriages, using Qi correct calendar, sacrificing to heaven and earth — ritual, music, and institutions all using Qi canon.
translations.idiomatic: Enfeoffed the Qi Emperor as King of Baling, full sustenance one commandery, bearing Son of Heaven banners and flags, riding five-season secondary carriages, using Qi correct calendar, sacrificing to heaven and earth — ritual, music, and institutions all using Qi canon.

sentences.zh: 以齊宣德皇后為齊文帝妃，齊帝后王氏為巴陵王妃，齊代王侯封爵，悉皆降省，其效著艱難者，別有後命。

translations.literal: Made Qi Empress Dowager Xuande Consort of Qi Emperor Wen, Qi Emperor's consort née Wang Consort of Baling — Qi age kings and marquises enfeoffments, all reduced and simplified; those whose effect was manifest in hardship — separately later command.
translations.idiomatic: Made Qi Empress Dowager Xuande Consort of Qi Emperor Wen, Qi Emperor's consort née Wang Consort of Baling — Qi age kings and marquises enfeoffments, all reduced and simplified; those whose effect was manifest in hardship — separately later command.

sentences.zh: 惟宋汝陰王不在除例。

translations.literal: Only Song Prince of Runan was not in the removal category.
translations.idiomatic: Only Song Prince of Runan was not in the removal category.

sentences.zh: 劫賊餘口沒在台府者，悉皆蠲放。

translations.literal: Remaining mouths of bandits and robbers detained in the palace offices — all remitted and released.
translations.idiomatic: Remaining mouths of bandits and robbers detained in the palace offices — all remitted and released.

sentences.zh: 諸流徙之家，並聽還本。

translations.literal: All exiled and moved families — all permitted to return home.
translations.idiomatic: All exiled and moved families — all permitted to return home.

sentences.zh: 以兼尚書令王亮為尚書令，兼尚書右僕射沈約為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: Made Concurrent Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang Director of the Masters of Writing, Concurrent Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Yue Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Made Concurrent Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang Director of the Masters of Writing, Concurrent Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Yue Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 封皇弟中護軍宏為臨川王，南徐州刺史秀為安成王，雍州刺史偉為建安王，左衛將軍恢為鄱陽王，荊州刺史憺為始興王。
