sentences.zh: 是歲，魏正始元年。

translations.literal: That year, first year of Zhengshi of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In that year, first year of Zhengshi of Wei.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸卯，詔「自今九流常選，年未三十，不通一經，不得解褐；

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, on guimao, an edict, "From now in regular selection of the nine ranks, if age not yet thirty and not penetrating one classic — may not remove coarse garb;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year fourth, on guimao, an edict, "From now in regular selection of the nine ranks, if age not yet thirty and not penetrating one classic — may not remove coarse garb;

sentences.zh: 若有才同甘、顏，勿限年次」。

translations.literal: if talent equal to Gan and Yan — do not limit by year order."
translations.idiomatic: if talent equal to Gan and Yan — do not limit by year order.".

sentences.zh: 置五經博士各一人。

translations.literal: Established one Doctor of the Five Classics each.
translations.idiomatic: Established one Doctor of the Five Classics each.

sentences.zh: 有司奏：吳令唐傭鑄盤龍火爐、翔鳳硯蓋。

translations.literal: The relevant offices memorialized: Magistrate of Wu Tang Yong cast coiled-dragon fire brazier and soaring-phoenix inkstone cover.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices memorialized: Magistrate of Wu Tang Yong cast coiled-dragon fire brazier and soaring-phoenix inkstone cover.

sentences.zh: 詔禁錮終身。

translations.literal: An edict imprisoned for life.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict imprisoned for life.

sentences.zh: 丙午，省鳳凰銜書伎。

translations.literal: On bingwu, abolished the phoenix holding document performers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, abolished the phoenix holding document performers.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔「往代多命宮人帷宮觀禋郊之禮，非所以仰虔蒼昊，自今停止」。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict, "Former ages often ordered palace women for suburban and sacrificial rites — not thereby to reverently face azure heaven; from now stop."
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, an edict, "Former ages often ordered palace women for suburban and sacrificial rites — not thereby to reverently face azure heaven; from now stop.".

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinhai, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; a general amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 二月，初置胄子律博士。

translations.literal: In the second month, first established the Crown Prince's Law Doctor.
translations.idiomatic: During the second month, first established the Crown Prince's Law Doctor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遣衛尉卿楊公則率宿衛兵塞洛口。

translations.literal: On renwu, dispatched Commandant of the Guards Yang Gongze leading palace guard troops to block Luokou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, dispatched Commandant of the Guards Yang Gongze leading palace guard troops to block Luokou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，交州刺史李凱據州反，長史李畟討平之，曲赦交州。

translations.literal: On renchen, Governor of Jiao Li Kai held the province in rebellion; Chief Administrator Li Yi suppressed and pacified — partial amnesty for Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Governor of Jiao Li Kai held the province in rebellion; Chief Administrator Li Yi suppressed and pacified — partial amnesty for Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 是月立建興苑於秣陵建興裏。

translations.literal: That month established Jianxing Park at Jianxing Village, Moling.
translations.idiomatic: That month established Jianxing Park at Jianxing Village, Moling.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，以行宕昌王梁彌博為安西將軍、河涼二州刺史，正封宕昌王。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the fourth month of summer, made Acting King of Dangchang Liang Mibo Grand General Who Pacifies the West, Governor of He and Liang — formally enfeoffed King of Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi, made Acting King of Dangchang Liang Mibo Grand General Who Pacifies the West, Governor of He and Liang — formally enfeoffed King of Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，立孔子廟。

translations.literal: On gengxu of the sixth month, established Confucius's temple.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixth month, on gengxu, established Confucius's temple.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，使中軍將軍、揚州刺史臨川王宏都督北討諸軍事侵魏。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, sent Central Army General, Governor of Yang Prince of Linchuan Hong as Area Commander of northern expedition armies to invade Wei.
translations.idiomatic: During the tenth month of winter, sent Central Army General, Governor of Yang Prince of Linchuan Hong as Area Commander of northern expedition armies to invade Wei.

sentences.zh: 以興師費用，王公以下各上國租及田穀以助軍資。

translations.literal: Because of raising-army expense, kings, dukes, and below each submitted state rent and field grain to aid military funds.
translations.idiomatic: Because of raising-army expense, kings, dukes, and below each submitted state rent and field grain to aid military funds.

sentences.zh: 是歲大穰，米斛三十。

translations.literal: That year great harvest — thirty per hu of rice.
translations.idiomatic: That year great harvest — thirty per hu of rice.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁卯朔，詔「凡諸郡國舊族邦內無在朝位者，選官搜括，使郡有一人」。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, on dingmao new moon, an edict, "Of all commanderies and states, old clans within the district without court position — selection offices search and gather, making one man per commandery."
translations.idiomatic: During the first month of the fifth year, on dingmao new moon, an edict, "Of all commanderies and states, old clans within the district without court position — selection offices search and gather, making one man per commandery."

sentences.zh: 乙亥，起前司徒謝朏為中書監、司徒。

translations.literal: On yihai, raised former Minister Over the Masses Xie Tiao as Director of the Masters of Writing, Minister Over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, raised former Minister Over the Masses Xie Tiao as Director of the Masters of Writing, Minister Over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 甲申，立皇子綱為晉安王。

translations.literal: On jiashen, established the imperial son Gang as Prince of Jin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the imperial son Gang was established as Prince of Jin'an.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On bingyin new moon of the third month of summer, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin new moon of the third month of summer, the sun had been eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，初立詔獄。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the fourth month of summer, first established the edict-imprisonment office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin, first established the edict-imprisonment office.

sentences.zh: 詔建康縣置三官，與廷尉三官分掌獄事，號建康為南獄，廷尉為北獄。

translations.literal: An edict established three offices in Jiankang County, with the Court of Judicature's three offices dividing prison affairs — called Jiankang the Southern Prison, Court of Judicature the Northern Prison.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict established three offices in Jiankang County, with the Court of Judicature's three offices dividing prison affairs — called Jiankang the Southern Prison, Court of Judicature the Northern Prison.

sentences.zh: 五月，置集雅館以招遠學。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, established the Jiya Lodge to gather distant learning.
translations.idiomatic: During the fifth month, established the Jiya Lodge to gather distant learning.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，鄧至國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On yichou of the seventh month of autumn, Dengzhi sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yichou, Dengzhi sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，作東宮。

translations.literal: On xinyou of the eighth month, constructed the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: During the eighth month, on xinyou, constructed the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月，臨川王宏軍至洛口，大潰，所亡萬計，宏單騎而歸。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Prince of Linchuan Hong's army reached Luokou and collapsed greatly — losses numbered in the tens of thousands; Hong returned alone on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: During the ninth month, Prince of Linchuan Hong's army reached Luokou and collapsed greatly — losses numbered in the tens of thousands; Hong returned alone on horseback.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲子，都下地震，生白毛。

translations.literal: On jiazi of the eleventh month of winter, the capital earthquake — white hair grew.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiazi, the capital earthquake — white hair grew.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以師出淹時，大赦。

translations.literal: On yichou, because the army's departure dragged on time, general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, because the campaign had dragged on, general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 魏人乘勝攻鍾離。

translations.literal: Wei men pressed victory and attacked Zhongli.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei forces pressed their victory and attacked Zhongli.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，司徒謝朏薨。

translations.literal: On guimao of the twelfth month, Minister Over the Masses Xie Tiao died.
translations.idiomatic: During the twelfth month, on guimao, Minister Over the Masses Xie Tiao died.

sentences.zh: 六年春三月庚申，隕霜殺草。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year of spring, on gengshen, falling frost killed grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year sixth (spring), on gengshen, falling frost killed grass.

sentences.zh: 是月，有三象入建鄴。

translations.literal: That month, three elephants entered Jianye.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, three elephants entered Jianye.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰，置左右驍騎、左右遊擊將軍官。

translations.literal: On renchen of the fourth month of summer, established Left and Right Valiant Cavalry and Left and Right Mobile Strike General offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renchen, established Left and Right Valiant Cavalry and Left and Right Mobile Strike General offices.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，曹景宗、韋叡等破魏師于邵陽洲，斬獲萬計。

translations.literal: On guisi, Cao Jingzong, Wei Rui, and others broke Wei troops at Shaoyang Isle — slain and captured numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Cao Jingzong, Wei Rui, and others broke Wei troops at Shaoyang Isle — slain and captured numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以江州刺史王茂為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On jiyou, made Governor of Jiang Wang Mao Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, made Governor of Jiang Wang Mao Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以揚州刺史臨川王宏為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，以右光祿大夫沈約為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On dingsi, made Governor of Yang Prince of Linchuan Hong Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon; made Right Grand Master of the Bright Hall Shen Yue Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, made Governor of Yang Prince of Linchuan Hong Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon; made Right Grand Master of the Bright Hall Shen Yue Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，置中衛、中權將軍，改驍騎為雲騎，遊擊為遊騎。

translations.literal: On jisi of the fifth month, established Central Guard and Central Authority Generals; changed Valiant Cavalry to Cloud Cavalry, Mobile Strike to Mobile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: During the fifth month, on jisi, established Central Guard and Central Authority Generals; changed Valiant Cavalry to Cloud Cavalry, Mobile Strike to Mobile Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊子，赦。

translations.literal: On wuzi of the eighth month of autumn, amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on wuzi, amnesty.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，都下大水。

translations.literal: On wuxu, great flood in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, great flood in the capital.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，改閱武堂為德陽堂，聽訟堂為儀賢堂。

translations.literal: On yihai of the ninth month, changed Review Troops Hall to Deyang Hall, Hear-Lawsuit Hall to Exalt-Worthies Hall.
translations.idiomatic: During the ninth month, on yihai, changed Review Troops Hall to Deyang Hall, Hear-Lawsuit Hall to Exalt-Worthies Hall.

sentences.zh: 冬閏十月乙丑，以開府臨川王宏為司徒，以行太子太傅；

translations.literal: On yichou of the intercalary tenth month of winter, made Grand Master with Golden Seal Prince of Linchuan Hong Minister Over the Masses, acting Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent;
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the intercalary tenth month of winter, made Grand Master with Golden Seal Prince of Linchuan Hong Minister Over the Masses, acting Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent;.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射沈約為尚書令，以行太子少傅；

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Yue Director of the Masters of Writing, acting Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent;
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Yue Director of the Masters of Writing, acting Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent;.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書袁昂為兼尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Yuan Ang Concurrent Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Yuan Ang Concurrent Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以左光祿大夫夏侯詳為左僕射。

translations.literal: On jiashen, made Left Grand Master of the Bright Hall Xiahou Xiang Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, made Left Grand Master of the Bright Hall Xiahou Xiang Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，左僕射夏侯詳卒。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the twelfth month, Left Vice Director Xiahou Xiang died.
translations.idiomatic: During the twelfth month, on bingchen, Left Vice Director Xiahou Xiang died.

sentences.zh: 七月春正月戊子，以元樹為恒、朔二州都督，封魏郡王。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year of spring, on wuzi, made Yuan Shu Area Commander of Heng and Shuo, enfeoffed King of Wei Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: During the first month of the seventh year of spring, on wuzi, made Yuan Shu Area Commander of Heng and Shuo, enfeoffed King of Wei Commandery.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔作神龍、仁獸闕於端門、大司馬門外。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict constructed Spirit Dragon and Benevolent Beast towers at the Duan Gate and outside the Grand Marshal Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, an edict constructed Spirit Dragon and Benevolent Beast towers at the Duan Gate and outside the Grand Marshal Gate.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，新作國門于越城南。

translations.literal: On yimao of the second month, newly constructed the state gate south of Yue city.
translations.idiomatic: During the second month, on yimao, newly constructed the state gate south of Yue city.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，增置鎮衛將軍以下為十品，以法日數；

translations.literal: On yichou, additionally established General Who Guards the Garrison and below as ten grades, following sun numbers;
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, additionally established General Who Guards the Garrison and below as ten grades, following sun numbers;.

sentences.zh: 凡二十四班，以法氣序；

translations.literal: altogether twenty-four ranks, following qi sequence;
translations.idiomatic: altogether twenty-four ranks, following qi sequence;.

sentences.zh: 不登十品，別有八班，以象八風；

translations.literal: not ascending ten grades — separately eight ranks, symbolizing eight winds;
translations.idiomatic: not ascending ten grades — separately eight ranks, symbolizing eight winds;.

sentences.zh: 又置施外國將軍二十四班，合一百九號。

translations.literal: also established Foreign General with twenty-four ranks — altogether one hundred nine titles.
translations.idiomatic: also established Foreign General with twenty-four ranks — altogether one hundred nine titles.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔於州郡縣置州望、郡宗、鄉豪各一人，專掌搜薦。

translations.literal: On gengwu, an edict at provinces, commanderies, and counties established one each of Province Expectation, Commandery Ancestor, and Village Hero — exclusively managing search and recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, an edict at provinces, commanderies, and counties established one each of Province Expectation, Commandery Ancestor, and Village Hero — exclusively managing search and recommendation.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以車騎大將軍高麗王高雲為撫東大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On yihai, made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry King Gao of Goguryeo Grand General Who Pacifies the East, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry King Gao of Goguryeo Grand General Who Pacifies the East, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，以皇太子納妃故，赦大辟以下，頒賜朝臣及近侍各有差。

translations.literal: On yimao of the fourth month of summer, because the Crown Prince received a consort, amnesty for capital crimes and below; distributed gifts to court ministers and close attendants each with difference.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao, because the Crown Prince received a consort, amnesty for capital crimes and below; distributed gifts to court ministers and close attendants each with difference.

sentences.zh: 五月，都下大水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, great flood in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: During the fifth month, great flood in the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔蘭陵縣建修二陵周回五里內居人賜復終身。

translations.literal: On wuzi, an edict granted lifelong exemption to residents within five li of the Jian and Xiu tombs at Lanling County.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, an edict granted lifelong exemption to residents within five li of the Jian and Xiu tombs at Lanling County.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔復置宗正、太僕、大匠、鴻臚，又增太府、太舟，仍先為十二卿，及置朱衣直合將軍官。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict restored Director of the Imperial Clan, Grand Master of the Stud, Grand Master of Craftsmen, Grand Master for Guests; also added Grand Master of the Treasury, Grand Master of Boats — again the twelve ministers; and established Vermilion-Robe Direct Attendant General office.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, an edict restored Director of the Imperial Clan, Grand Master of the Stud, Grand Master of Craftsmen, Grand Master for Guests; also added Grand Master of the Treasury, Grand Master of Boats — again the twelve ministers; and established Vermilion-Robe Direct Attendant General office.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，改陵監為令。

translations.literal: On xinyou of the sixth month, changed Tomb Supervisor to Tomb Director.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixth month, on xinyou, changed Tomb Supervisor to Tomb Director.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁巳，皇子繹生，赦大辟以下未結正者。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the eighth month of autumn, the imperial son Yi was born; amnesty for capital crimes and below not yet concluded.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on dingsi, the imperial son Yi was born; amnesty for capital crimes and below still pending were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，置童子奉車郎。

translations.literal: On renchen of the ninth month, established the Youth Attendant of the Imperial Carriage Gentleman office.
translations.idiomatic: During the ninth month, on renchen, established the Youth Attendant of the Imperial Carriage Gentleman office.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，立皇子績為南康王。

translations.literal: On guisi, established the imperial son Ji as Prince of Nankang.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the imperial son Ji was established as Prince of Nankang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，以吳興太守張稷為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On bingyin of the tenth month of winter, made Governor of Wuxing Zhang Ji Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingyin, made Governor of Wuxing Zhang Ji Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔大舉北侵。

translations.literal: On bingzi, an edict for a great northern invasion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, an edict for a great northern invasion.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，魏縣瓠鎮主白皁生、豫州刺史胡遜以城內屬。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Wei County Gushu garrison commander Bai Zaosheng and Governor of Yu Hu Xun surrendered the city within.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Wei County Gushu garrison commander Bai Zaosheng and Governor of Yu Hu Xun surrendered the city within.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏永平元年。

translations.literal: That year, first year of Yongping of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In that year, first year of Yongping of Wei.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月辛巳，祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year of spring, on xinsi, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year of spring, on xinsi, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; a general amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，魏鎮東參軍成景雋以宿預城內屬。

translations.literal: On renchen, Wei Pacifying East Staff Officer Cheng Jingjun surrendered Xi Prefecture city within.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Wei Pacifying East Staff Officer Cheng Jingjun surrendered Xi Prefecture city within.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，以司徒臨川王宏為司空、揚州刺史，以車騎將軍、領太子詹事王茂即本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On wushen of the fourth month of summer, made Minister Over the Masses Prince of Linchuan Hong Minister of Works, Governor of Yang; made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Concurrent Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Wang Mao Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon at his existing title.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wushen, made Minister Over the Masses Prince of Linchuan Hong Minister of Works, Governor of Yang; made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Concurrent Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Wang Mao Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon at his existing title.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，巴陵王蕭寶義薨。

translations.literal: On guisi of the seventh month of autumn, King of Baling Xiao Baoyi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guisi, King of Baling Xiao Baoyi died.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬寅，立皇子續為廬陵王。

translations.literal: On renyin of the eleventh month of winter, established the imperial son Xu as Prince of Luling.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on renyin, the imperial son Xu was established as Prince of Luling.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月乙亥，以右光祿大夫王瑩為尚書令。

translations.literal: On yihai of the first month of the ninth year of spring, made Right Grand Master of the Bright Hall Wang Ying Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the first month of the ninth year of spring, made Right Grand Master of the Bright Hall Wang Ying Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，新作緣淮塘。

translations.literal: On gengyin, newly constructed the embankment along the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, newly constructed the embankment along the Huai.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，幸國子學，親臨講肄，賜祭酒以下各有差。

translations.literal: On jichou of the third month, visited the Imperial Academy, personally lectured and studied, bestowed on the Libationer and below each with difference.
translations.idiomatic: During the third month, on jichou, visited the Imperial Academy, personally lectured and studied, bestowed on the Libationer and below each with difference.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔皇太子及王侯之子，年在從師者，皆入學。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict: the Crown Prince and kings' and marquises' sons, in years of following teachers — all enter learning.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, an edict: the Crown Prince and kings' and marquises' sons, in years of following teachers — all enter learning.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，選尚書五都令史，革用士流。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the fourth month of summer, selected the Masters of Writing five capital clerks — reformed to use gentry stream.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi, selected the Masters of Writing five capital clerks — reformed to use gentry stream.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，盜殺宣城太守朱僧勇。

translations.literal: On guichou of the sixth month, bandits killed Governor of Xuancheng Zhu Sengyong.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixth month, on guichou, bandits killed Governor of Xuancheng Zhu Sengyong.

sentences.zh: 閏六月己丑，宣城盜轉寇吳興，太守蔡撙討平之。

translations.literal: On jichou of the intercalary sixth month, Xuancheng bandits turned to raid Wuxing; Governor Cai Chan suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the intercalary sixth month, Xuancheng bandits turned to raid Wuxing; Governor Cai Chan suppressed and pacified.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月癸未，幸國子學，策試胄子，賜訓授之司各有差。

translations.literal: On guiwei of the twelfth month of winter, visited the Imperial Academy, tested the Crown Prince's students, bestowed on the instructing offices each with difference.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on guiwei, visited the Imperial Academy, tested the Crown Prince's students, bestowed on the instructing offices each with difference.

sentences.zh: 是歲，于闐、林邑國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Khotan and Lin Yi each sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In that year, Khotan and Lin Yi each dispatched envoys to court bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月辛丑，祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year of spring, on xinchou, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year of spring, on xinchou, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; a general amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，荊州言騶虞見。

translations.literal: On wushen, Jing Province reported the zouyu appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Jing Province reported the zouyu appeared.

sentences.zh: 三月，盜殺東莞、琅邪二郡太守劉晰，以朐山引魏徐州刺史盧昶。

translations.literal: In the third month, bandits killed Governors of Dongguan and Langye Liu Xi, using Qushan to draw in Wei Governor of Xu Lu Chang.
translations.idiomatic: During the third month, bandits killed Governors of Dongguan and Langye Liu Xi, using Qushan to draw in Wei Governor of Xu Lu Chang.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，以國子祭酒張充為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, made Imperial Academy Libationer Zhang Chong Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixth month of summer, made Imperial Academy Libationer Zhang Chong Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，山車見臨城縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, the mountain carriage appeared at Lincheng County.
translations.idiomatic: During the twelfth month of winter, the mountain carriage appeared at Lincheng County.

sentences.zh: 振遠將軍馬仙崥大破魏軍，斬馘十餘萬，復朐山城。

translations.literal: General Who Shakes the Distance Ma Xiancheng greatly broke Wei army — slain and severed ears over a hundred thousand; recovered Qushan city.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Shakes the Distance Ma Xiancheng greatly broke Wei army — slain and severed ears over a hundred thousand; recovered Qushan city.

sentences.zh: 是歲，初作宮城門三重樓及開二道。

translations.literal: That year, first constructed the palace city gate triple towers and opened two roads.
translations.idiomatic: In that year, first constructed the palace city gate triple towers and opened two roads.

sentences.zh: 宕昌國遣使朝貢，婆利國貢金席。

translations.literal: Dangchang sent envoys to court with tribute; Poli presented a gold mat.
translations.idiomatic: Dangchang sent envoys to court with tribute; Poli presented a gold mat.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月壬辰，詔「自今逋謫之家，及罪應質作，若年有老小，可停將送」。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year of spring, on renchen, an edict, "From now for families of exiled and demoted, and crimes deserving bonded labor — if there are aged and small in the household, may halt sending to corvée."
translations.idiomatic: During the first month of the eleventh year of spring, on renchen, an edict, "From now for families of exiled and demoted, and crimes deserving bonded labor — if there are aged and small in the household, may halt sending to corvée."

sentences.zh: 加鎮南將軍、江州刺史建安王偉開府儀同三司，司空、揚州刺史臨川王宏進位元元太尉，以驃騎將軍王茂為司空。

translations.literal: Added General Who Pacifies the South, Governor of Jiang Prince of Jian'an Wei Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon; Minister of Works, Governor of Yang Prince of Linchuan Hong advanced to Grand Preceptor; made Grand General of Agile Cavalry Wang Mao Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Added General Who Pacifies the South, Governor of Jiang Prince of Jian'an Wei Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon; Minister of Works, Governor of Yang Prince of Linchuan Hong advanced to Grand Preceptor; made Grand General of Agile Cavalry Wang Mao Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，新昌、濟陽二郡野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: On wuchen of the second month, Xinchang and Jiyang two commanderies' wild silkworms formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: During the second month, on wuchen, Xinchang and Jiyang two commanderies' wild silkworms formed cocoons.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，為旱故，曲赦揚、徐二州。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the third month, because of drought, partial amnesty for Yang and Xu two provinces.
translations.idiomatic: During the third month, on dingsi, because of drought, partial amnesty for Yang and Xu two provinces.

sentences.zh: 庚申，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Goguryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Goguryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，百濟、扶南、林邑等國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Baekje, Funan, Lin Yi, and other states each sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Baekje, Funan, Lin Yi, and other states each dispatched envoys to court bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋九月，宕昌國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, Dangchang sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: During the ninth month of autumn, Dangchang sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏延昌元年。

translations.literal: That year, first year of Yan chang of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In that year, first year of Yan chang of Wei.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月辛卯，祀南郊，赦大辟罪以下。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twelfth year of spring, on xinmao, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; amnesty for capital crimes and below.
translations.idiomatic: During the first month of the twelfth year of spring, on xinmao, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; amnesty for capital crimes and below.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，兼尚書右僕射袁昂即正。

translations.literal: On xinyou of the second month, Concurrent Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang assumed the regular post.
translations.idiomatic: During the second month, on xinyou, Concurrent Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang assumed the regular post.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔「明下遠近，若委骸不葬，或篨衣莫改，量給棺具收斂」。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict, "Make known near and far — if abandoned bones are not buried, or hemp garments not changed — according to measure provide coffins and implements for gathering and burial."
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, an edict, "Make known near and far — if abandoned bones are not buried, or hemp garments not changed — according to measure provide coffins and implements for gathering and burial.".

sentences.zh: 辛巳，新作太極殿，改為十三間，以從閏數。

translations.literal: On xinsi, newly constructed the Supreme Ultimate Hall, changed to thirteen bays, following intercalary number.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, newly constructed the Supreme Ultimate Hall, changed to thirteen bays, following intercalary number.

sentences.zh: 閏三月乙丑，特進、中軍將軍沈約卒。

translations.literal: On yichou of the intercalary third month, Special Advisor, Central Army General Shen Yue died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the intercalary third month, Special Advisor, Central Army General Shen Yue passed away.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，都下大水。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, great flood in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: During the fourth month of summer, great flood in the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，新作太廟，增基九尺。

translations.literal: On guisi of the sixth month, newly constructed the Grand Temple, foundation increased nine chi.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixth month, on guisi, newly constructed the Grand Temple, foundation increased nine chi.

sentences.zh: 秋九月，加揚州刺史臨川王宏位元元司空，以司空王茂為驃騎將軍、開府同三司之儀、江州刺史。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, added Governor of Yang Prince of Linchuan Hong rank Grand Preceptor; made Minister of Works Wang Mao Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, Governor of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: During the ninth month of autumn, added Governor of Yang Prince of Linchuan Hong rank Grand Preceptor; made Minister of Works Wang Mao Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, Governor of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，詔曰：「明堂地居卑濕，可量就埤起，以盡誠敬。」

translations.literal: On dinghai of the tenth month of winter, an edict said, "The Bright Hall's ground occupies low damp — may according to measure be raised on the mound, thereby exhausting reverence."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dinghai, an edict said, "The Bright Hall's ground occupies low damp — may according to measure be raised on the mound, thereby exhausting reverence."

sentences.zh: 十三年春二月庚辰朔，震於西南，天如裂。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirteenth year of spring, on gengchen new moon, earthquake in the southwest — heaven as if splitting.
translations.idiomatic: During the second month of the thirteenth year of spring, on gengchen new moon, earthquake in the southwest — heaven as if splitting.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，耕藉田，大赦，賜孝悌力田爵一級。

translations.literal: On dinghai, plowed the sacred field; general amnesty; bestowed on filial piety and diligent farming rank one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, plowed the sacred field; general amnesty; bestowed on filial piety and diligent farming rank one grade.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，都下訛言有棖棖，取人肝肺及血，以飴天狗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, false rumor in the capital that there were cheng-cheng taking men's liver and lungs and blood, to feed the heavenly dog.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixth month of summer, false rumor in the capital that there were cheng-cheng taking men's liver and lungs and blood, to feed the heavenly dog.

sentences.zh: 百姓大懼，二旬而止。

translations.literal: Common people greatly feared — in two ten-day periods it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Common people greatly feared — in two ten-day periods it stopped.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，立皇子綸為邵陵王、繹為湘東王、紀為武陵王。

translations.literal: On yihai of the seventh month of autumn, established the imperial son Lun as Prince of Shaoling, Yi as Prince of Xiangdong, Ji as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai, the imperial son Lun was established as Prince of Shaoling, Yi as Prince of Xiangdong, Ji as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 是歲，林邑、扶南、于闐國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Lin Yi, Funan, and Khotan each sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In that year, Lin Yi, Funan, and Khotan each dispatched envoys to court bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 作浮山堰。

translations.literal: Constructed the Fushan dam.
translations.idiomatic: Constructed the Fushan dam.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月乙巳朔，皇太子冠，大赦，賜為父後者爵一級，王公以下班賚各有差。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year of spring, on yisi new moon, the Crown Prince capped; general amnesty; bestowed on fathers of heirs rank one grade, kings and dukes and below graded gifts each with difference.
translations.idiomatic: During the first month of the fourteenth year of spring, on yisi new moon, the Crown Prince capped; general amnesty; bestowed on fathers of heirs rank one grade, kings and dukes and below graded gifts each with difference.

sentences.zh: 停遠近上慶禮。

translations.literal: Stopped near and far congratulatory rites.
translations.idiomatic: Stopped near and far congratulatory rites.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祀南郊，詔班下遠近，博采英異。

translations.literal: On xinhai, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; an edict distributed near and far, broadly gathering outstanding and unusual.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; an edict distributed near and far, broadly gathering outstanding and unusual.

sentences.zh: 又前以墨刑用代重辟者，除其條。

translations.literal: Also earlier because ink punishment replaced heavy capital crimes — abolished that statute.
translations.idiomatic: Also earlier because ink punishment replaced heavy capital crimes — abolished that statute.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，汝陰王劉胤薨。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Prince of Runan Liu Yin died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Prince of Runan Liu Yin passed away.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，魏宣武皇帝崩。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Emperor Xuanwu of Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Emperor Xuanwu of Wei passed away.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，驃騎將軍、開府同三司之儀、江州刺史王茂薨。

translations.literal: On dingchou of the fourth month of summer, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, Governor of Jiang Wang Mao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingchou, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, Governor of Jiang Wang Mao died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，浮山堰壞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Fushan dam broke.
translations.idiomatic: During the tenth month of winter, the Fushan dam broke.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、狼牙修國各遣使來朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Rouran and Langyaxiu each sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In that year, Rouran and Langyaxiu each dispatched envoys to court bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十五年春三月戊辰朔，日有蝕之，既。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifteenth year of spring, on wuchen new moon, the sun was eclipsed — total.
translations.idiomatic: During the third month of the fifteenth year of spring, on wuchen new moon, the sun had been eclipsed — total.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Goguryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: During the fourth month of summer, Goguryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，以尚書令王瑩為左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，尚書右僕射袁昂為左僕射，吏部尚書王暕為右僕射。

translations.literal: On gengzi of the sixth month, made Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Ying Left Grand Master of the Bright Hall, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon; Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang Left Vice Director; Minister of Personnel Wang Yan Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixth month, on gengzi, made Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Ying Left Grand Master of the Bright Hall, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon; Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang Left Vice Director; Minister of Personnel Wang Yan Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，蠕蠕、河南國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, Rouran and Henan each sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, Rouran and Henan each dispatched envoys to court bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司王瑩薨。

translations.literal: On xinsi of the ninth month, Left Grand Master of the Bright Hall, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Wang Ying died.
translations.idiomatic: During the ninth month, on xinsi, Left Grand Master of the Bright Hall, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Wang Ying died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，大赦。

translations.literal: On renchen, general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，交州刺史李畟斬反者阮宗孝，傳首建鄴。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Governor of Jiao Li Yi beheaded the rebel Ruan Zongxiao, sent the head to Jianye.
translations.idiomatic: During the eleventh month of winter, Governor of Jiao Li Yi beheaded the rebel Ruan Zongxiao, sent the head to Jianye.

sentences.zh: 曲赦交州。

translations.literal: Partial amnesty for Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: Partial amnesty for Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏孝明皇帝熙平元年。

translations.literal: That year, first year of Xiping of Emperor Xiaoming of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In that year, first year of Xiping of Emperor Xiaoming of Wei.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月辛未，祀南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixteenth year of spring, on xinwei, sacrificed at the Southern Altar.
translations.idiomatic: During the first month of the sixteenth year of spring, on xinwei, sacrificed at the Southern Altar.

sentences.zh: 詔尤貧家勿收今年三調，無田業者，所在量宜賦給；

translations.literal: An edict: extremely poor households do not collect this year's three levies; those without field estates — where they are, according to measure grant and give;
translations.idiomatic: An edict: extremely poor households do not collect this year's three levies; those without field estates — where they are, according to measure grant and give;.

sentences.zh: 及優蠲產子之家，恤理冤獄，並賑孤老鰥寡不能自存者。

translations.literal: and favorably remit households bearing children, soothe and settle wrongful prisons, and relief to solitary old, widows, and orphans unable to support themselves.
translations.idiomatic: and favorably remit households bearing children, soothe and settle wrongful prisons, and relief to solitary old, widows, and orphans unable to support themselves.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the second month, plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: During the second month, on xinhai, plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，赦罪人。

translations.literal: On jiayin, amnesty for criminals.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, amnesty for criminals.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，敕太醫不得以生類為藥；

translations.literal: On bingzi of the third month, ordered the Imperial Physicians not to use living creatures as medicine;
translations.idiomatic: During the third month, on bingzi, ordered the Imperial Physicians not to use living creatures as medicine;

sentences.zh: 公家織官紋錦飾，並斷仙人鳥獸之形，以為褻衣，裁翦有乖仁恕。

translations.literal: government weaving offices' brocade ornamentation — all cut images of immortals, birds, and beasts, using them as inner garments, cutting and trimming contrary to benevolence and forbearance.
translations.idiomatic: government weaving offices' brocade ornamentation — all cut images of immortals, birds, and beasts, using them as inner garments, cutting and trimming contrary to benevolence and forbearance.

sentences.zh: 於是祈告天地宗廟，以去殺之理，欲被之含識。

translations.literal: Thereupon prayed and announced to heaven, earth, and the ancestral temple — with the principle of removing killing, wishing to spread it to all sentient beings.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon prayed and announced to heaven, earth, and the ancestral temple — with the principle of removing killing, wishing to spread it to all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 郊廟牲牷，皆代以面，其山川諸祀則否。

translations.literal: Suburban and temple sacrificial victims — all replaced with dough; mountain and river various sacrifices then not.
translations.idiomatic: Suburban and temple sacrificial victims — all replaced with dough; mountain and river various sacrifices then not.

sentences.zh: 時以宗廟去牲，則為不復血食，雖公卿異議，朝野喧囂，竟不從。

translations.literal: At the time because the ancestral temple removed victims, then it was as if no longer blood-eating — though lords and ministers differed in opinion, court and wild clamored — in the end they did not follow.
translations.idiomatic: At the time because the ancestral temple removed victims, then it had been as if no longer blood-eating — though lords and ministers differed in opinion, court and wild clamored — in the end they did not follow.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，宗廟薦羞，始用蔬果。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, ancestral temple offerings — first used vegetables and fruits.
translations.idiomatic: During the tenth month of winter, ancestral temple offerings — first used vegetables and fruits.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河南、扶南、婆利等國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Henan, Funan, Poli, and other states each sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In that year, Henan, Funan, Poli, and other states each dispatched envoys to court bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十七年春二月癸巳，雍州刺史安成王秀薨。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventeenth year of spring, on guisi, Governor of Yong Prince of Ancheng Xiu died.
translations.idiomatic: During the second month of the seventeenth year of spring, on guisi, Governor of Yong Prince of Ancheng Xiu passed away.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiachen, general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，改封建安郡王偉為南平王。

translations.literal: On bingyin of the third month, changed enfeoffment of Prince of Jian'an Commandery Wei to Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: During the third month, on bingyin, changed enfeoffment of Prince of Jian'an Commandery Wei to Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 夏六月乙酉，中軍將軍、中書監臨川王宏以本號行司徒。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the sixth month of summer, Central Army General, Director of the Masters of Writing Prince of Linchuan Hong acted as Minister Over the Masses at his existing title.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the sixth month of summer, Central Army General and Director of the Masters of Writing Prince of Linchuan Hong served as acting Minister Over the Masses under his existing title.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬寅，詔「兵騶奴婢，男年六十六，女年六十，免為編戶」。

translations.literal: On renyin of the eighth month of autumn, an edict, "Military grooms and slave servants — men age sixty-six, women age sixty — freed as registered households."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on renyin, an edict, "Military grooms and slave servants — men age sixty-six, women age sixty — freed as registered households."

sentences.zh: 閏八月，幹陀利國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eighth month, Gandhara sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: During the intercalary eighth month, Gandhara sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，以行司徒臨川王宏即正。

translations.literal: On yihai of the tenth month of winter, Acting Minister Over the Masses Prince of Linchuan Hong assumed the regular post.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yihai, Acting Minister Over the Masses Prince of Linchuan Hong assumed the regular post.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，以南平王偉為左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the eleventh month, made Prince of Nanping Wei Left Grand Master of the Bright Hall, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: During the eleventh month, on xinhai, made Prince of Nanping Wei Left Grand Master of the Bright Hall, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏神龜元年。

translations.literal: That year, first year of Shen gui of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In that year, first year of Shen gui of Wei.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月甲申，以領軍將軍鄱陽王恢為征西將軍、荊州刺史，以荊州刺史始興王憺為中撫將軍，並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighteenth year of spring, on jiashen, made General Who Leads the Army Prince of Poyang Hui Grand General Who Conquers the West, Governor of Jing; made Governor of Jing Prince of Shixing Dan Central Pacifying General — both Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: During the first month of the eighteenth year of spring, on jiashen, made General Who Leads the Army Prince of Poyang Hui Grand General Who Conquers the West, Governor of Jing; made Governor of Jing Prince of Shixing Dan Central Pacifying General — both Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左僕射袁昂為尚書令，以右僕射王暕為左僕射，以太子詹事徐勉為右僕射。

translations.literal: Made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang Director of the Masters of Writing; Right Vice Director Wang Yan Left Vice Director; Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Xu Mian Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang Director of the Masters of Writing; Right Vice Director Wang Yan Left Vice Director; Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Xu Mian Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祀南郊，孝悌力田賜爵一級。

translations.literal: On xinmao, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; filial piety and diligent farming bestowed rank one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, sacrificed at the Southern Altar; filial piety and diligent farming bestowed rank one grade.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，帝於無礙殿受佛戒，赦罪人。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the fourth month of summer, the Emperor at the Unhindered Hall received Buddhist precepts; amnesty for criminals.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi, the Emperor at the Unhindered Hall received Buddhist precepts; amnesty for criminals.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，于闐、扶南國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Khotan and Funan each sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Khotan and Funan each dispatched envoys to court bearing tribute.
